title: Capital flows — income to channels
notes: Owner-confirmed 2026-07-24: Turo / Lyft (default) / ASIC revenue → Coinbase → BTC → Morpho collateral → USDC. Lyft express pay → X Money. ASIC fleet OpEx from X Money (expense sheet). Monthly $ variable — diagram is structural (relative weights), not dollar-accurate yet.

legend.observed: Seen in YNAB/Plaid or updated expense sheet
legend.owner_stated: Confirmed by owner (may not yet be fully tagged in ledger)
legend.inferred: Implied by strategy; not fully verified in every txn

income_sources.label: Turo
income_sources.evidence: Payouts deposit to Coinbase; model = cash → auto BTC → Morpho BTC collateral for USDC borrow. Cadence follows rental activity (not fixed schedule).

income_sources.label: Lyft
income_sources.evidence: Default: weekly payout to Coinbase (same Morpho/BTC path as Turo). Express pay (manual): lands on X Money — observed as Lyft inflows on Checking – 2201 in YNAB.

income_sources.label: ASICs (mining revenue)
income_sources.evidence: Payouts set to Coinbase; same path as Turo (cash → BTC → Morpho collateral for USDC). Distinct from fleet OpEx (expense) and ASIC hardware purchases (capex).
